title: max_packets_per_hour missing window_s validation
description:
File: python/src/lichen/timing/duty_cycle.py
Line: 190-201

Bug: The function accepts window_s parameter without validation. If window_s <= 0, the function silently returns incorrect results (0 or negative packet count).

Contrast with duty_cycle_usage_percent (line 206-208) which correctly validates:
  if window_s <= 0:
      raise ValueError("window_s must be positive")

Impact: Silent incorrect calculation of max packets per hour. A caller passing window_s=0 would get 0 packets regardless of other parameters, and window_s<0 returns negative values.

Fix: Add validation matching duty_cycle_usage_percent:
  if window_s <= 0:
      raise ValueError("window_s must be positive")
close_reason: Validated window_s before packet-count arithmetic; focused duty-cycle suites pass (67 tests) and ruff lint is clean.
